title: Retrospective telemetry rescoring and tenant quarantine gateway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: we need a safe, tenant-aware pipeline component that can retroactively rescore historical telemetry (feature flips, quality scores, embeddings-derived metadata) and selectively reingest updated records into the analytics warehouse. Existing reprocess tools focus on full replays or diff-application; they either overload downstream storage or lack per-tenant cost caps and fine-grained quarantining for malformed/poisoned rows. This ticket implements a gateway that orchestrates resumable rescoring jobs with tenant-level budgets, schema-driven mappers, idempotent delta application, and quarantine/verify flows before final commit.
design_notes: Gateway sits between historical event iterator and reingest worker; responsible for tenant budgeting, schema transformations, and quarantine routing.
Rescoring is pluggable: scorer adapters for model-based rescoring (embedding+ML-score) and deterministic rule-based recalculations.
Idempotence via content-hash + original-event-timestamp checkpointing. Each applied mutation stores a tombstone/sidecar record to avoid double-applying across retries.
Tenant cost cap enforced using tokenized budget buckets: gateway decrements budget estimate before dispatch; worker reconciles actual token usage and reports deltas.
Quarantine queue implemented as a topic in streaming infra (Kafka topic: analytics-retro-quarantine) with consumer tooling for manual review + automated heuristics.

Schema morph layer uses canonical mapping table (Confluence: Console Analytics Schema Versioning) to translate legacy fields to current warehouse schema; failures route to quarantine with reason codes.
Safety: soft-commit staging table per-tenant in warehouse for verification using existing QA queries; automatic rollback if verification thresholds exceed drift tolerances.
Canary mode: start with 1% of tenants (low-traffic) and synthetic trace checks before expanding.
Operational hooks: runbook, metrics, and dashboard for progress, cost burn, malformed rate, and applied-change rate.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway can process historical event stream and produce a per-tenant plan of candidate mutations without committing to warehouse (dry-run) and report estimated token cost.
End-to-end idempotent reingest for a single tenant test scope (10k events): after repeated runs, applied-change rate is stable and no duplicates are present.
Quarantine routing captures >95% of schema/validation failures with clear reason codes and associated messages for triage.
Tenant-level cost caps prevent jobs from exceeding configured monthly backfill budget (simulate with test budgets).
Canary run completed for the first cohort (10 tenants) and dashboards show expected delta distribution and <0.1% regression on key analytics queries.
Runbook published and on-call aware; at least 2 SRE/analytics engineers have run the playbook in staging.
implementation_plan: Phase A: Gateway core skeleton + historical iterator adapter + budget accounting (2 sprints).
Phase B: Scorer adapter interface + rule-based rescoring implementation + schema morph integration (1 sprint).
Phase C: Quarantine topic + consumer tooling + staging table commit and verification checks (1 sprint).
Phase D: Canary rollout tooling, dashboards, and runbook + postmortem template (1 sprint).
Deliver incremental PRs: gateway skeleton -> budget -> scorer -> quarantine -> canary orchestration.
rollout_plan: Start in staging with synthetic historical snapshots (sanitized).
Run dry-run for 50 low-volume tenants and compare staging vs production analytics queries to validate semantics.
Enable canary cohort (10 tenants) in production during low-traffic window; monitor cost burn and query regressions for 48h.
Gradually expand cohorts using exponential ramp (10 -> 50 -> 200) with manual gates and automated rollback on thresholds.
Full rollout to all tenants only after three successful cohorts and a REQ: <0.2% query regression over 7 days.
testing_plan: Unit tests for scorer adapters and schema morph mappings with synthetic legacy payloads.
Integration tests for idempotence and checkpointing under retries and worker restarts.
Property-based tests on budget accounting to ensure no off-by-one under concurrent job starts.
Chaos tests: kill worker mid-run and verify resume semantics from checkpoint.
Load tests simulating token / compute variance to tune gateway backpressure parameters.
monitoring_and_slo: Metric: retrogateway.processed_events_total by tenant and outcome (applied|quarantined|skipped).
Alert: >1% quarantine rate sustained for 30m for a tenant -> page analytics-owner.
SLO: successful canary completion within expected window 95% of the time for ramp cohorts.
Dashboards: per-tenant burn, applied-change velocity, verification pass rate, stale-checkpoint age.
